title: Add New Component
description: Create a new React component with specified features
content: Create a {{componentName}} component that {{functionality}}. Use Tailwind CSS for styling and include hover states and transitions.
author: Ersin KOÇ

title: Add Feature to Page
description: Add a new feature or section to an existing page
content: Add a {{featureName}} section to the {{pageName}}. It should {{requirements}}. Match the existing design style.
author: Ersin KOÇ

variables.name: requirements
variables.default: show 3 customer reviews with avatar, name, and quote

title: Fix Styling Issue
content: Fix the styling issue in {{componentName}}: {{issue}}. Ensure it looks correct on all screen sizes.
author: Ersin KOÇ

variables.name: issue
variables.default: elements are not aligned properly on mobile

title: Add Form Validation
description: Add client-side validation to a form
content: Add form validation to {{formName}} with the following rules: {{validationRules}}. Show inline error messages and disable submit until valid.
author: Ersin KOÇ

variables.name: validationRules
variables.default: email must be valid, name required, message min 10 chars

title: Create Dashboard Widget
description: Add a metric/stat widget to a dashboard
content: Create a dashboard widget that displays {{metricType}}. Include {{features}}. Use appropriate icons from lucide-react.
author: Ersin KOÇ

variables.name: features
variables.default: trend arrow, sparkline chart, and comparison to last period
